paragraphs: From the very first day, we were there — watching it all happen. We heard it with our own ears, saw it with our own eyes, and touched it with our own hands. The Word of Life showed up right in front of us, and we saw it happen. And now we're telling you plainly: what we saw was incredible — the eternal life of God himself, taking shape right before our eyes.

We saw it, we heard it — and now we're passing it on so you can experience it with us. This is about being close to the Father and his Son, Jesus Christ. The reason we're writing is simple: we want you to share in this joy too. Your joy will double our joy!
§Walk in the Light
Here's the message we heard from Christ, and now we're passing it to you: God is light — pure light. There is not even a trace of darkness in him.

If we claim to share life with him but keep wandering around in the dark, we're lying through our teeth — we're not living what we claim. But if we walk in the light, with God himself as the light, we share life with each other, and the sacrificed blood of Jesus, God's Son, washes away all our sin.

If we say we're totally free of sin, we're only fooling ourselves — that's just nonsense. But if we admit our sins and come clean about them, he won't let us down; he'll stay true to himself. He'll forgive our sins and cleanse us from all wrongdoing. And if we claim we've never sinned at all, we're calling God a liar — which only shows we don't really know him.

paragraphs: I'm writing this, dear children, to help you stay out of sin. But if anyone does sin, we have a Priest-Friend before the Father: Jesus Christ, righteous Jesus. When he gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins, he solved the sin problem for good — not just for us, but for the whole world.
§The Only Way to Know We're in Him
Here's how we can be sure we know God in the right way: keep his commandments.

If someone says, "I know him well!" but doesn't keep his commandments, that person is clearly a liar — their life doesn't match their words. But when someone keeps God's word, we see God's love growing mature in them. This is the only way to be sure we're in God. And anyone who claims to be close to God should live the same kind of life Jesus lived.

My dear friends, nothing here is new. This is the oldest commandment in the book, and you've known it from day one. It's always been part of the message you heard. On the other hand, it is new in a fresh way — freshly minted in both Christ and in you: the darkness is fading, and the true light is already shining bright.

If someone claims to live in God's light but hates a brother or sister, they're still in the dark. But when you love your brother or sister, you live in God's light — and you don't block the light from reaching others. Whoever hates is still in the dark, stumbling around, not knowing which way is up, blinded by the darkness.
§Loving the World

Let me remind you, dear children: your sins are forgiven in Jesus' name. You who have been here since the beginning — you know the One who started all this. And you newcomers — you've won a huge victory over the Evil One.

One more reminder, dear children: you know the Father from personal experience. You veterans know the One who started it all. And you newcomers — what energy and strength! God's word is firmly planted in you, and your friendship with God gives you the strength to win over the Evil One.

Don't fall in love with the world's ways. Don't fall in love with the world's stuff. Loving the world pushes out your love for the Father. Pretty much everything the world runs on — wanting your own way, wanting everything for yourself, wanting to look important — has nothing to do with the Father. It only pulls you away from him. The world and all its endless wanting is on its way out — but whoever does what God wants is set for eternity.
§Antichrists Everywhere You Look
Children, time is almost up. You heard that Antichrist is coming — and look around: there are antichrists everywhere. That's how we know we're close to the end.
They left us — but they were never really with us. If they had been, they would have stayed, loyal to the end. By leaving, they showed their true colors: they never really belonged.

But you belong. The Holy One has anointed you, and you all know it. I'm not writing to tell you something you don't know — I'm confirming the truth you already know, and reminding you that the truth never produces lies.

So who is the liar here? The person who denies that Jesus is the Divine Christ — that's the one. This is what makes someone an antichrist: denying the Father and denying the Son. Anyone who denies the Son has nothing to do with the Father — but affirming the Son means embracing the Father too.

Stay with what you heard from the beginning — the original message. Let it sink deep into your life. If what you heard from the beginning lives deeply in you, you will live deeply in both the Son and the Father. This is exactly what Christ promised: eternal life — real life!

I've written this to warn you about the people trying to deceive you. But they are no match for what's deep inside you — Christ's anointing! You don't need their so-called teaching. Christ's anointing teaches you the truth about everything you need to know — about yourself and about him — without a single lie mixed in. So live deeply in what you were taught.
§Live Deeply in Christ
And now, children, stay with Christ. Live deeply in Christ. Then when he appears, we'll be ready — ready to welcome him with open arms, with no guilty blushing and no lame excuses.
Once you're convinced that he is right and righteous, you'll recognize that everyone who practices righteousness is truly God's child.

paragraphs: Look at the amazing love the Father has shown us! Just think — we're called children of God! And that's who we really are. But that's also why the world doesn't recognize us or take us seriously: they have no idea who he is or what he's up to.

But friends, that's exactly who we are: children of God. And that's just the beginning! Who knows how amazing we'll become! What we do know is this: when Christ is revealed, we will see him — and by seeing him, we'll become like him. All of us who look forward to his coming stay ready, with the pure and shining life of Jesus as our model.

Everyone who lives a sinful life is living dangerously outside God's law, because sin is a major disruption of God's order. You know that Christ came to get rid of sin — there is no sin in him, and sin is not part of his plan. No one who lives deeply in Christ keeps practicing sin. And none of those who do practice sin have really seen Christ — they've got him completely backward.

So, my dear children, don't let anyone pull you away from the truth. The person who does what's right is right — just like our righteous Messiah. But those who keep practicing sin are straight from the Devil, the original inventor of sin. The Son of God came to destroy the Devil's works.

People born of God don't keep practicing sin. How could they? God's seed is planted deep inside them, making them who they are. It's simply not in the nature of the God-born to practice and show off sin. Here's how you can tell God's children from the Devil's children: anyone who doesn't practice what is right isn't from God — and neither is anyone who won't love a brother or sister. Simple test.
Here's the original message we heard from the start: we should love each other.

Don't be like Cain, who joined the Evil One and killed his brother. Why did he do it? Because he was deep in the practice of evil, while his brother's actions were righteous. So don't be surprised, friends, when the world hates you. This has been going on for a long time.

We know we've moved from death to life because we love our brothers and sisters. Anyone who doesn't love is as good as dead. And anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer — and you know very well that eternal life and murder don't go together.

This is how we've come to understand and experience love: Christ gave up his life for us. That's why we should be willing to give sacrificially for our fellow believers — not just look out for ourselves. If you see a brother or sister in need and you have the means to help, but you ignore them and do nothing — what happens to God's love? It disappears. And you made it disappear.
§When We Practice Real Love

My dear children, let's not just talk about love — let's practice real love. This is the only way we'll know we're living truly, living in God's reality. It's also how we shut down that harsh inner critic, even when it has a point. Because God is greater than our worried hearts, and he knows more about us than we know about ourselves.

And friends, once we've stopped accusing and condemning ourselves, we're bold and free before God! We can reach out and receive what we asked for, because we're doing what he said — doing what pleases him. Again, this is God's command: believe in his Son, Jesus Christ, the Son he named personally. He also told us to love each other, following the original command. As we keep his commands, we live deeply and securely in him, and he lives in us. And this is how we experience his deep, steady presence in us: through the Spirit he gave us.

paragraphs: §Don't Believe Everything You Hear
My dear friends, don't believe everything you hear. Carefully check what people tell you — not everyone who talks about God comes from God. There are a lot of lying preachers out there in the world.

Here's how you test for the genuine Spirit of God: everyone who openly confesses faith in Jesus Christ — the Son of God, who came as a real flesh-and-blood person — comes from God and belongs to God. But anyone who refuses to confess faith in Jesus has nothing in common with God. This is the spirit of antichrist you heard was coming — and here it is, sooner than expected!

My dear children, you come from God and you belong to God. You've already won a great victory over those false teachers, because the Spirit in you is far stronger than anything in the world. Those people belong to the world that rejects Christ — they speak the world's language, and the world loves it. But we come from God and belong to God. Anyone who knows God understands us and listens. The person who has nothing to do with God simply won't listen. This is another test for telling the Spirit of Truth from the spirit of deception.
§God Is Love

My beloved friends, let's keep loving each other, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves is born of God and experiences a relationship with God. But the person who refuses to love doesn't know the first thing about God — because God is love, so you can't know him if you don't love. This is how God showed his love for us: God sent his only Son into the world so we could live through him. And this is the kind of love we're talking about — not that we once loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as a sacrifice to clear away our sins and repair the damage they did to our relationship with God.

My dear, dear friends, if God loved us like this, we certainly should love each other. No one has ever seen God — ever. But when we love each other, God lives deeply in us, and his love becomes complete in us — perfect love!

This is how we know we're living steadily and deeply in him, and he in us: he has given us life from his own life — from his very own Spirit. We've also seen with our own eyes, and we keep saying it openly: the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. Everyone who confesses that Jesus is God's Son stays in a continuous, close relationship with God. We know this so well — we've embraced it with all our hearts — this love that comes from God.
§To Love, to Be Loved

God is love. When we settle permanently into a life of love, we live in God and God lives in us. This way, love runs the whole house — it becomes at home and grows mature in us — so we have nothing to fear on Judgment Day, because our standing in the world is the same as Christ's. There is no room for fear in love. Well-formed love drives out fear. Since fear is crippling, a fearful life — fear of death, fear of judgment — is a life not yet fully formed in love.
As for us, we're going to love — love and be loved. We were loved first, and now we love. He loved us first.

If anyone brags, "I love God," but keeps hating a brother or sister without a second thought, that person is a liar. If you won't love the person you can see, how can you love the God you can't see? The command we have from Christ is clear: loving God includes loving people. You've got to love both.

paragraphs: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Messiah is born of God. If we love the One who gave life to the child, we'll surely love the child he brought to life. Here's the reality check on whether we truly love God's children: Do we love God? Do we keep his commands? The proof that we love God shows up when we keep his commandments — and they don't feel like a burden at all.
§The Power That Brings the World to Its Knees

Every God-born person conquers the world's ways. The power that brings the world to its knees is our faith. The one who wins over the world's ways is simply the one who believes Jesus is the Son of God.

Jesus — the Divine Christ! He experienced a life-giving birth and a death-defeating death. Not just birth from the womb, but the baptism that launched his ministry and the death that was his sacrifice. And through it all, the Spirit is confirming the truth — showing us that God was really present at Jesus' baptism and crucifixion, making those moments come alive for us. A triple testimony: the Spirit, the baptism, the crucifixion. And all three agree completely.

If we trust what people tell us, how much more should we trust it when God himself testifies — testifying about his own Son. Whoever believes in the Son of God confirms God's testimony deep inside. But whoever refuses to believe is basically calling God a liar, refusing to believe God's own testimony about his Son.
Here is the testimony in a nutshell: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. So whoever has the Son has life — and whoever rejects the Son rejects life.
§The Reality, Not the Illusion

I'm writing so that you who believe in God's Son will know beyond the shadow of a doubt that you have eternal life — the real thing, not a fake. And with that confidence, we become bold and free in his presence, asking freely according to his will, sure that he's listening. And if we know he's listening, we know that what we've asked for is as good as ours.

For example, if you see a fellow believer sinning — and I clearly don't mean someone who keeps sinning in a 'fatal' way that leads to eternal death — pray for them, ask God for help, and he will gladly give it. He gives life to the sinner whose sin isn't fatal. There is such a thing as fatal sin, and I'm not telling you to pray about that. Everything wrong we do is sin — but not all sin is fatal.

We know that none of the God-born keeps practicing sin — fatal sin. The God-born are also God-protected: the Evil One can't touch them. We know we are held firm by God — it's only the people of the world who stay in the grip of the Evil One. And we know that the Son of God came so we could recognize and understand God's truth — what a gift! And we are living in the Truth itself, in God's Son, Jesus Christ. This Jesus is both true God and real life. Dear children, watch out for every clever imitation.
title: The Ultimate Win
